changes.comment: Fixes the documentation build. `tsconfig.docs.json` named `@types/node` in `compilerOptions.types`, which this package does not depend on and does not need — its only mentions of Buffer and process are inside comments — so TypeDoc failed with TS2688. Because four DevTools packages depend on this one, Rush blocked their documentation too, and the whole suite silently produced no API reference. No published code changes.
